primary_defect.reported_scenario: Plan a 6 hour trip in Bhubaneswar

root_cause_forensics.cause_1_probe_omission: In M13 Phase 0 evaluation, the probe payload submitted was {'days': 1, 'interests': ['heritage']} with start=None. When start was None, RankingService assigned proximity_tier=0 and distance_km=0.0 to every destination statewide, falling back to alphabetical sorting by category and name.
root_cause_forensics.cause_2_proximity_tier_threshold: RankingService._calculate_proximity used a single static threshold of <= 45.0 km for Tier 0. For single-day trips, 45 km permitted inter-district candidates in Salepur (32.1 km) to compete in the top tier against destinations within 1 km.
root_cause_forensics.cause_3_missing_intra_day_clustering: ItineraryService.plan naively sliced eligible[:days * max_stops] without verifying that consecutive stops on the same day were within feasible intra-day transit windows.
root_cause_forensics.cause_4_ai_word_number_mismatch: extract_multilingual_days matched only digit hour patterns (e.g. '6 hours'), causing 'six hours' to return None and default to 2 days.
root_cause_forensics.cause_5_ai_prepositional_start_extractio: _resolve_start_location checked 30 districts before prepositional phrases, matching 'Puri' in 'Start in Bhubaneswar and take me to Puri' because Puri is a district while Bhubaneswar is not.

corrections_implemented.ranking_service: Calibrated proximity tiers in RankingService: for days==1, Tier 0 is <= 25.0 km (immediate urban continuum), Tier 1 is <= 55.0 km, Tier 2 is <= 100.0 km, Tier 3 is > 100.0 km.
corrections_implemented.itinerary_service: Implemented _select_clustered_places in ItineraryService: intra-day stops strictly cluster within <= 25.0 km of the day's anchor for 1-day trips, and <= 45.0 km for multi-day trips.
corrections_implemented.multilingual_extractor: Updated extract_multilingual_days regex to support written number words (one..twelve, Odia, Hindi).
corrections_implemented.model_adapter: Updated _resolve_start_location to check explicit start prepositions ('start in/from/at', 'from', 'in') before scanning all districts.
